postgres_requirements.rationale: A real PostgreSQL probe is MANDATORY for these six controls. They discharge the node authority amendment v1.0.2's new probe family PG-CE3-ACL-HARDENING, which advances REAL_PG_NODE_CONTRACT.probe_count_total from 13 to 14 while leaving all thirteen prior families -- PG-4, PG-7, PG-CE3-SEC3, PG-CE3-SEC4, PG-CE3-TENANT-ISOLATION, PG-CE3-APPEND-ONLY, PG-CE3-SOURCE-VALIDATION, PG-CE3-LIMIT-VALIDATION, PG-CE3-EFFECTIVE-PERIOD, PG-CE3-EXPLICIT-ORG, PG-CE3-NO-CE4-CONSUMER, PG-CE3-UNGOVERNED and PG-CE3-DEFINER-OWNER -- unchanged in id and in semantics. || THE SUBSTRATE IS HOSTED-SHAPED, AND THAT IS FROZEN, NOT ADVISORY: the disposable database MUST (1) reproduce the hosted platform's pg_default_acl rows for the baseline-applier role in schema public and MEASURE them by reading pg_default_acl back before the baseline is applied; (2) create public.entitlement_grants by the ACTUAL baseline-applier identity; (3) NOT re-home public.entitlement_grants to uellix_owner; (4) apply the REAL bytes of stella_hosted_0009 BEFORE the REAL bytes of stella_hosted_0010. A substrate that fails any of the four does not discharge the family, because on it the defect never existed and the proof is vacuous -- which is exactly what CE3-ACL-M-1's substrate arm detects. The container IMAGE is not frozen; the MEASURED pg_default_acl content is. The CE-3 suite's current default image postgres:16-alpine (scripts/db-audit-disposable.ts DEFAULT_IMAGE at BASE_SHA) carries no such rows on a fresh database and the current fixture re-homes every table at line 201, so the current fixture as it stands does NOT satisfy this requirement; how the later act satisfies it (a narrowed loop or a separate hosted-shaped fixture) is that act's write-surface decision. || WHY BOTH PATHS ARE UNKNOWN, measured rather than asserted: the repository carries TWO admissible real-PG shapes -- some suites pair a *.pg.test.ts with an explicit harness and a *.probes.json; others, including CE-1's tests/postgres/ce1-commercial-account.pg.test.ts and CE-3's own tests/postgres/ce3-entitlement-grants.pg.test.ts at 7c178862, carry no probes.json at all. Guessing a path here would be wrong for the closest sibling precedents. See authority_reference for the exact rule under which the later act may materialize these two fields, and the condition under which it must leave them UNKNOWN. || WHAT IS FROZEN AND MAY NOT BE VARIED: the cluster is DISPOSABLE ONLY, via the repository's disposable-audit path -- NEVER staging, NEVER production, NEVER the canonical local stack. Separate login identities per the node base's harness.separate_login_identities: tenant attempts run AS authenticated with rolbypassrls asserted false; the platform attempt runs AS service_role with rolbypassrls asserted TRUE; the package runs AS the administrative identity; every refusal is asserted on SQLSTATE 42501, never on an empty result. The probe MUST apply the REAL bytes of db/prepared/stella_hosted_0010_entitlement_grants_acl_hardening.sql, not a re-implementation of what that file does, and MUST read every ACL through aclexplode and every role flag from pg_roles rather than inferring either from an observed row count.

sentinels.purpose: A synthetic, disposable-only role (created and dropped inside the probe, never present on any governed target) that the CE3-ACL-N-3 arrangement (c) GRANTs a privilege on public.entitlement_grants or EXECUTE on public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar) BEFORE attempting the hosted0010 package, solely to prove that the package REFUSES on an unexpected third non-owner grantee rather than tolerating it or silently revoking it. It is the known-positive instrument for the unexpected-grantee refusal: a package reported to refuse third grantees without having been shown to refuse this one has proven nothing. The role name must be unmistakably synthetic and must never be granted anything outside the probe's own transaction.

A synthetic arrangement, disposable-only, in which a target (grantee, privilege) pair on one of the two objects is attributed to a grantor the administrative session cannot SET ROLE to, so that a naive REVOKE issued by that session would raise 'WARNING: no privileges could be revoked' and change nothing. It exists solely so that CE3-ACL-N-3 arrangements (a) and (b) can prove the package REFUSES BEFORE mutation (wrong grantor) and, where a REVOKE is nonetheless attempted in a controlled harness step, that the no-op is detected as FAILURE by ACL re-read rather than reported as success. It is the known-positive instrument for the anti-seizure doctrine. It must never be applied to any governed target.

A synthetic, non-executed SQL string containing a GRANT on public.entitlement_grants (and, in a second variant, an EXECUTE format(...) dynamic-SQL form), planted solely so that CE3-ACL-N-4's static statement-class detector can be proven to FLAG it. It is the known-positive instrument control for the REVOKE-only assertion: a scanner that reports the package REVOKE-only without having been shown to flag this sentinel has proven nothing, because a zero-hit result is indistinguishable from a scan whose pattern matches nothing. The sentinel must never be applied to any database and must live where it cannot be mistaken for package bytes.

positive_controls.description: HOSTED_SHAPED_ACL_HARDENING_PACKAGE_APPLIED_AND_EXACT. Proves, as ONE conjunction, on a HOSTED-SHAPED substrate: (1) SUBSTRATE NON-VACUITY -- the platform's pg_default_acl rows for the baseline-applier role in schema public are present and are READ BACK from pg_default_acl as a measured assertion (tables: ALL to authenticated and service_role, anon revoked; functions: EXECUTE to anon, authenticated, service_role); public.entitlement_grants' owner, read from pg_class.relowner, is the baseline-applier identity and is NOT uellix_owner; (2) ORDER -- the REAL bytes of db/prepared/stella_hosted_0009_entitlement_evaluator_ownership.sql are applied, then the REAL bytes of db/prepared/stella_hosted_0010_entitlement_grants_acl_hardening.sql, each matching its registry sha256 pin through sha256OfPreparedSql; (3) TABLE EXACTNESS -- the non-owner (grantee, privilege) set on public.entitlement_grants, read through aclexplode(COALESCE(relacl, acldefault('r', relowner))), is EXACTLY {(uellix_owner, SELECT)}; (4) FUNCTION EXACTNESS -- the non-owner EXECUTE holders on public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar), read through aclexplode(COALESCE(proacl, acldefault('f', proowner))), are EXACTLY {authenticated}; PUBLIC, anon and service_role are absent; the owner is uellix_owner with rolsuper false and rolbypassrls false; (5) UNCHANGED -- against a capture taken BEFORE hosted0010: relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity both true, the policy set exactly one (entitlement_grants_select_owner FOR SELECT TO uellix_owner), the trigger set, the table owner, the evaluator owner and the evaluator's body / prosecdef / provolatile / proparallel / proleakproof / proconfig digest are all IDENTICAL; (6) IDEMPOTENCY -- a SECOND application of hosted0010 in a fresh transaction succeeds, issues ZERO REVOKEs (asserted by the ACL being byte-identical before and after and by the package's own governed output), and satisfies every postcondition. THE SUBSTRATE ASSERTIONS (1) ARE PART OF THIS CONTROL AND ARE LOAD-BEARING: without them (3)-(6) are satisfiable on a fixture-shaped substrate where the defect never existed. Authorized by COMMERCIAL_ACCOUNT_CE3_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_AMENDMENT_v1.0.2 REQUIRED_NODE_CONTROLS_AMENDED_V102 and discharged through probe family PG-CE3-ACL-HARDENING.

negative_controls.description: TENANT_ROLE_DIRECT_TABLE_ACCESS_REFUSED. Proves that, after hosted0010 on the hosted-shaped substrate, a session running AS authenticated -- with pg_roles.rolbypassrls asserted FALSE for it -- has EACH of SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE on public.entitlement_grants REFUSED with SQLSTATE 42501. Asserted on the FAILURE CODE for every one of the five, NEVER on an empty result set or a zero row count: before hosted0010 the same SELECT returns zero rows under RLS and the same TRUNCATE SUCCEEDS, and a test that accepted 'no rows' would be green on the unhardened substrate. The relation's row count, read as the administrative identity, is UNCHANGED after all five attempts, and SENTINEL_SIBLING_ORG_CANARY_ROW (reused from the base manifest, not redefined) is absent from every result set, log line and error payload. KNOWN-POSITIVE INSTRUMENT: the same five attempts on the same substrate WITHOUT hosted0010 must NOT all refuse (discharged by CE3-ACL-M-1), which is what proves the refusal is produced by the REVOKE and not by the fixture. This is the storage-boundary form of the node authority's BINDING append_only_mutation_restriction and of the parent's append_only_rule, closing D1 (a tenant TRUNCATE that RLS and the FOR EACH ROW trigger cannot reach).

PLATFORM_BYPASSRLS_ROLE_DIRECT_ACCESS_REFUSED_AND_CANARY_UNDISCLOSED. Proves that, after hosted0010 on the hosted-shaped substrate, a session running AS service_role -- with pg_roles.rolbypassrls asserted TRUE for it, so that row-level security is KNOWN NOT to be the protecting mechanism -- has direct SELECT on public.entitlement_grants REFUSED with SQLSTATE 42501, has INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE likewise refused with 42501, and holds NO EXECUTE on public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar) (has_function_privilege('service_role', ..., 'EXECUTE') false); that anon holds no EXECUTE on the evaluator; that PUBLIC holds no EXECUTE on the evaluator; and that SENTINEL_SIBLING_ORG_CANARY_ROW is ABSENT from every result set, log line and error payload of every attempt, including the service_role attempts. THE rolbypassrls = TRUE ASSERTION IS WHAT MAKES THIS CONTROL NON-VACUOUS: a service_role created without BYPASSRLS would be refused by RLS for the wrong reason and the control would be green without the REVOKE being load-bearing. This closes D2 and is the mechanical form of the node amendment's SERVICE_ROLE_CLASSIFICATION (UNUSED_PRIVILEGED_PLATFORM_ROLE, relation-specific least-privilege exception).

PACKAGE_REFUSES_WRONG_GRANTOR_NOOP_REVOKE_AND_UNEXPECTED_GRANTEE. Proves THREE refusals of the REAL hosted0010 package bytes, each from a controlled disposable-only arrangement, each REFUSED with the package's GOVERNED message (asserted on that message, not on a generic error) BEFORE any mutation, and each leaving both objects' ACLs byte-identical to their pre-attempt capture: (a) WRONG GRANTOR -- the package is applied by a session for which pg_has_role(current_user, <measured grantor>, 'SET') is false and current_user <> grantor (SENTINEL_FOREIGN_GRANTOR_GRANT arrangement), and is refused at ACL-PRE-12; (b) NO-OP REVOKE DETECTED -- in an arrangement where a target grant is attributed to a grantor the session cannot assume, a REVOKE that PostgreSQL would accept with 'WARNING: no privileges could be revoked' and no effect is reported as FAILURE by the package's post-REVOKE ACL re-read, never as success -- a WARNING with no effective mutation is FAILURE; (c) UNEXPECTED GRANTEE -- with SENTINEL_ACL_UNEXPECTED_GRANTEE granted a privilege on public.entitlement_grants, and separately EXECUTE on the evaluator, and separately with PUBLIC granted EXECUTE on the evaluator, the package is refused at ACL-PRE-13 / ACL-PRE-11 and neither tolerates nor silently revokes the planted grant. DETECTOR REQUIREMENTS: each arrangement is the KNOWN-POSITIVE for its refusal; the conformant run of CE3-ACL-P-1 on the same substrate is the KNOWN-NEGATIVE that none of the three fires on; the package's governed message is asserted verbatim. This is the mechanical form of the node amendment's GRANTOR_ANTI_SEIZURE_CONTRACT: a package that cannot be shown to refuse has not been shown to measure.

PACKAGE_STATEMENT_CLASS_CLOSED. Proves, by STATIC source reading of db/prepared/stella_hosted_0010_entitlement_grants_acl_hardening.sql over a CODE-ONLY projection (comments stripped, string literals blanked), that the package is REVOKE-only: every top-level and DO-block state-changing statement is a REVOKE; ZERO occurrences of GRANT, CREATE, DROP, ALTER, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, CREATE POLICY, DROP POLICY, CREATE ROLE, GRANT <role> TO, and EXECUTE format(...) or any other dynamic-SQL form; every REVOKE names EXACTLY one of the two frozen target objects public.entitlement_grants or public.entitlement_effective(uuid,varchar) and no 'ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA' / 'ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA' form is present; every SET LOCAL ROLE is paired with a RESET ROLE in the same block; and the file's sha256 matches the db/hosted/prechain-ownership.ts pin through the repository's sha256OfPreparedSql mechanism rather than a transcribed constant. DETECTOR REQUIREMENTS, all four mandatory: (a) the detector MUST read the file as ONE SEMANTIC STRING -- a line-by-line grep is blind to a statement split across lines and is not an acceptable instrument; (b) the detector MUST have a KNOWN-POSITIVE control that it actually flags -- SENTINEL_DETECTOR_POSITIVE_GRANT_STATEMENT exists for exactly this, in both its GRANT and its dynamic-SQL variant; (c) the detector MUST have a KNOWN-NEGATIVE control, a REVOKE-only string superficially similar to the package that it does NOT flag; (d) the detector MUST assert a NON-ZERO searched population. A ZERO-HIT SCAN WITH NO INSTRUMENT PROOF IS NOT EVIDENCE. This is the mechanical form of category D_PRECHAIN_ACL_HARDENING_UNIT's statement-class restriction; a statement the database executes is a statement whether or not a scanner sees it, and the projection plus the instrument controls are what make 'REVOKE-only' a measurement.

mutation_controls.description: ACL_HARDENING_PACKAGE_OMISSION_MUTATION_GOES_RED. MUTATION ARM 1 (omission): remove, omit, or prevent the application of stella_hosted_0010 on the hosted-shaped substrate, leaving stella_hosted_0009, the fixture and the candidate INTACT. REQUIRED OUTCOME: CE3-ACL-P-1, CE3-ACL-N-1 and CE3-ACL-N-2 go RED. REQUIRED FAILURE REASON: they must fail BECAUSE authenticated's TRUNCATE succeeds and its SELECT returns rows-or-zero instead of 42501, BECAUSE service_role's direct SELECT succeeds and discloses SENTINEL_SIBLING_ORG_CANARY_ROW, and BECAUSE the non-owner ACLs are not the exact contracts. A RED produced by an unrelated crash, an import error, a missing-file exception or a harness timeout does NOT satisfy this control, because such a RED would also appear if the ACL assertions had been deleted entirely. NO SUBSTITUTE MAY RESCUE IT: no REVOKE issued by the fixture, and no REVOKE transcribed into a helper, a constant, a template literal or a second fixture anywhere in tests/**, may make the mutated arrangement GREEN. If a fixture-level REVOKE turns the suite green again, the proof was never grounded on the governed package. MUTATION ARM 2 (substrate non-vacuity): with hosted0010 STILL applied, replace the hosted-shaped substrate with a fixture-shaped one -- pg_default_acl rows absent, OR public.entitlement_grants re-homed to uellix_owner before the packages apply. REQUIRED OUTCOME: CE3-ACL-P-1 goes RED on its substrate assertions (the pg_default_acl read-back or the owner assertion), with that as the failure reason. If it stays green, the substrate assertions are decorative and the family is measuring a substrate on which the defect never existed.
